title: Decline Of The Sultanate
definition: The systemic disintegration of the Delhi Sultanate (1206–1526) caused by the erosion of central authority, economic exhaustion, and the failure of the Iqta system under the Lodi dynasty.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the transition from the Sultanate to the Mughal Empire and the evolution of administrative structures in Medieval India.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Decline Of The Sultanate.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
